programme.title: We Caught That
programme.desc: Capt. Jason Dozier joins Capt. Brian Sawyer on an exhilarating pursuit of Silver Kings prowling the waters of Homosassa.

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: Marathon in the Florida Keys is home to some of the most unique fishing in the world, and on this episode of Local Knowledge we’re experiencing it with one of the area’s most respected captains. Rush Maltz reunites with his longtime friend, Captain Jeff Rella of Superfish Charters, to explore the deep drop fishery of the middle keys and Marathon. Together they target awesome species including queen snapper, barrel-fish, snowy grouper, and tilefish. After action-packed day offshore, we unwind at the world-famous Hawks Cay Resort, one of the Florida Keys’ premier destinations for anglers, families, and anyone looking to experience island life at its best.

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: In this episode, Rush welcomes Cullen Lundholm from Cape Cod to experience Key West at its finest. Over several action-packed days, they target a variety of species in the incredible waters surrounding the Florida Keys. But the adventure doesn’t end at the dock—Cullen also experiences Key West’s world-class accommodations, exceptional food, and one-of-a-kind island lifestyle. From unforgettable fishing to first-class hospitality, this episode shows why Key West and the Florida Keys are among the world’s premier fishing and vacation destinations.

programme.title: In the Heat of the Night: Who Was Geli Bendl?
programme.desc: Only the sheriff (Carroll O'Connor) knows the identity of an actress (Sydne Rome) returned home to Sparta, Miss.

programme.title: Belly
programme.desc: Ever since they were kids, Sincere (Nas) and Buns (DMX) have lived life close to the edge, doing whatever it takes to survive. As adults, they build up their kingdom of crime on drug dealing and robbery. But Sincere grows weary of the criminal lifestyle and joins a black Muslim religious group. Buns, on the other hand, sinks deeper into criminality and faces serious prison time. The cops offer him a deal, however -- assassinate the head of the Muslim group, and he will go free.

programme.title: Belly 2: Millionaire Boyz Club
programme.desc: After eight years in prison, G (Jayceon Taylor) is released and returns to his old ways on the streets -- until he starts to fall for a policewoman (Shari Headley).

programme.title: State Property
programme.desc: Frustrated with being broke, "Beans" (Beanie Sigel) decides that the only way to grasp the American Dream is to take it. "State Property" follows Beans and his crew, the ABM as they take over the city, creating mayhem as their empire builds. Beans now struggles to maintain his family life, while bumping heads with opposing gangsters and the police. It all comes to a head when he cannot surpass the city's most notorious crew run by Untouchable J (Jay-Z) and Dame (Damon Dash).

programme.title: State Property 2
programme.desc: The gang war in Philadelphia is mostly centered around two rivals: Dame, the ruthless leader of the Umbrella organization, whose money and firepower have put him at the top of the crime world; and Beans, the one-time crime overlord hell-bent on taking back the city. The wild card is El Pollo Loco, a new player on the scene. His strategy involves teaming up with one side against the other -- but in reality, Loco has no plans to share Philadelphia with anyone.

programme.title: The Inspection
programme.desc: A young, gay Black man with few options for his future decides to join the Marines, willing to do whatever it takes to prove himself to his estranged mother and triumph in a system that would otherwise cast him aside. However, even as he battles deep-seated prejudice and the grueling rigor of basic training, he finds unexpected camaraderie, strength and support in this new community, giving him a hard-won sense of belonging that shapes his identity and forever changes his life.

programme.title: Soldier Boyz
programme.desc: Veteran Howard Toliver (Michael Dudikoff) works at a prison for extremely dangerous juvenile offenders. Recruited to rescue a wealthy girl being held captive in Vietnam, he assembles a team composed of some of the most violent inmates, many of whom are enemies. After battling their way through the jungle, they lay siege to the fortress of the brutal warlord Vinh Moc (Cary-Hiroyuki Tagawa), who has the hostage hidden away. Will they work together, or allow their rivalries to consume them?

programme.title: In the Heat of the Night: By Duty Bound
programme.desc: A murder suspect (Corbin Bernsen) works for a businessman running against Gillespie (Carroll O'Connor) for sheriff.

programme.title: The Message
programme.desc: Detective Andrea Oya and FBI agent Samantha Curry team up and hunt down a serial killer to solve a string of murders targeting Black women and Black children.

programme.title: A Snowy Day in Oakland
programme.desc: A beautiful psychologist from San Francisco decides to end a stalled romance with her high-profile psychiatrist boyfriend and business partner. She moves on with her life by opening her own practice in a vacant office space in the middle of a small commercial block located across the bay in Oakland, turning the predominately African American and psychologically ignored neighborhood on its emotional ear.

programme.title: From the Rough
programme.desc: Catana Starks becomes the first woman to coach a collegiate men's golf team and subsequently guides her misfit players to an all-time-record championship season.

programme.title: Five Star
programme.desc: A longtime gang member (James 'Primo' Grant) shows a fast-taking teen (John Diaz) how to operate on the mean streets of Brooklyn, N.Y.

programme.title: Rappin'
programme.desc: An ex-convict (Mario Van Peebles) shows residents of his Pittsburgh ghetto how to drive out riffraff with rap music.

programme.title: In the Heat of the Night: Give Me Your Life
programme.desc: As Gillespie (Carroll O'Connor) and Harriet prepare to leave for their honeymoon, Forbes (Carl Weathers) clashes with a charismatic cult leader (Peter Fonda) who has arrived in Sparta.

programme.title: In the Heat of the Night: A Matter of Justice
programme.desc: The trail of a serial killer leads the sheriff (Carroll O'Connor) and police chief (Carl Weathers) to a prominent citizen in Sparta, Miss.

programme.title: In the Heat of the Night: Who Was Geli Bendl?
programme.desc: Only the sheriff (Carroll O'Connor) knows the identity of an actress (Sydne Rome) returned home to Sparta, Miss.

programme.title: In the Heat of the Night: By Duty Bound
programme.desc: A murder suspect (Corbin Bernsen) works for a businessman running against Gillespie (Carroll O'Connor) for sheriff.

programme.title: El corrido de María Pistolas
programme.desc: Un hombre finge estar del lado de los ricos para enterarse de sus planes, y así los revolucionarios venzan en un ataque.

programme.title: Reencuentros
programme.desc: Al morir su hermano de leucemia, un niño pobre toma su bicicleta y emprende un viaje a la ciudad en busca de su padre.

programme.title: Cuna de valientes
programme.desc: En colegio militar, cuatro jóvenes se hacen amigos y juntos comparten mucho, pero solamente dos de ellos se gradúan.

programme.title: Las Pobres Ilegales
programme.desc: Una joven huye de su casa por su padrastro y se va a los EE.UU., donde descubre el abuso a los indocumentados.

programme.title: Milagro en el Barrio
programme.desc: Un niño ciego y el hijo de una rica familia se hacen amigos aún en contra de la voluntad de la madre del último.

programme.title: El Llanto de los Pobres
programme.desc: Un joven ilegal es acusado por un robo que no cometió, purga una condena en la cárcel donde sueña con volver a su país.

programme.title: Desvestidas y alborotadas
programme.desc: Una bella mujer es abandonada por su marido en su luna de miel, y los hombres en el hotel andan detrás de ella.

programme.title: Entre Cornudos te Veas
programme.desc: Una mujer va de vacaciones y es asediada por un deportista mientas su esposo coquetea con las clientas de su negocio.

programme.title: La Lucha con la Pantera
programme.desc: Tres muchachas confundidas con el sexo y el amor cometen errores llevados por el deseo carnal.

programme.title: El fin de un imperio
programme.desc: El teniente del batallón de Rurales, José Antonio Navarrete, es considerado héroe y enemigo de los imperialistas, quienes raptan a su gran amor para atraerlo e imponerle sus condiciones políticas.

programme.title: Me llaman violencia
programme.desc: Una mujer logra escapar de los asesinos de su padre, mientras huye conoce a un hombre que le ofrece protección.

programme.title: Bello amanecer
programme.desc: La espectacular belleza de una isleña que despierta entre los pescadores las más ardientes y locas pasiones.

programme.title: Mi nombre es Gatillo
programme.desc: Un hombre llamado el "Gatillo" solo tiene violencia en su sangre y su vida está controlada por las armas.

programme.title: Impaciencia del corazón
programme.desc: Un capitán herido es llevado a un pequeño pueblo y una joven lo cuida. Al final dos mujeres se enamoran de él.

programme.title: Muertes anunciadas
programme.desc: Un niño busca venganza por la muerte brutal de toda su familia, a manos de una banda de asesinos.

programme.desc: Drácula despierta de su tumba después de dormir por tres siglos y reclama más víctimas para su reino.

programme.title: Los dos hermanos

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: Contestants take part in death-defying, stomach-churning stunts. This time, it's a high-flying challenge with saws and mud, outrunning attack dogs, and a suspended bus escape.
programme.sub-title: Burger King Viewers Choice Fear Factor

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: Helicopter Fire Drill Players will have to climb out one side of the helicopter as it hovered twenty-five feet above the cold water, then traverse underneath the helicopter using a cargo net fastened to the runners. Only after they hoisted themselves back inside on the other side of the helicopter would their time complete.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: Contestants must retrieve flags from a tall pole, brave a piranha tank and play roulette to eat spiders

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: Miss USA Episode - Players will fall from platforms, eat sea cucumber and hang from bars until they drop.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: In the first stunt, contestants are locked in a Plexiglas cell as it filled with water. They have to find which of four keys unlocked the two locks at the top of the cell and open the hatch to escape. Eggs for the second stunt as the ones left have 20 minutes to drink a three-pound raw ostrich egg. For the final, they would have to walk a balance beam as it spun over 100 feet high

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: Contestants must retrieve items from the bottom of a tank filled with fish scales and surf tanker truck as they are bucked off by swerving drivers.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: This was the 90-minute finale of a two-part Championship edition. The remaining nine players will battle it out in the final stunts and compete for a grand prize of 100,000 dollars. Swim with Gators Inside a giant-sized fish tank, several alligators dropped into the water. The gators had razor-sharp teeth and lethal claws.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: Contestants will be locked in a plexiglass box that will be hung from a crane and lowered into the water leaving approx. 1-foot above the water for breathing. The other contestant will be outside of the box where they will build an unlocking device and free their partner. A contestant bobs into a tank of gelatinous fluid for animal tongues. The final team stunt includes a truck car ramp.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: Contestants will be standing on top of a plexiglass platform that covers the surface area of a water tank. On "go", the first team member must enter the water through a vertical tube. Contestants will be standing on a tube that is suspended approx. 100' in the air from a crane. The tube will begin to roll and the contestants must stay balanced on it.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: Contestants would be required to strip down to their birthday suits, parade along the runway for one minute.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: For the first stunt contestants have to hang from a helicopter skit and drop into the water below as the helicopter flew over a buoy. Once in the water, they would have to retrieve a flag from underneath the buoy, swim with it to a platform, and clip it on a flagpole.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: Contestants will be strapped by their waist, ankles, and one wrist and locked to the face of a 20-foot diameter wheel that is set halfway into the water. Contestants drink various types of disgusting liquids at the Fear Factor Bar. Contestants must stand on a swaying platform that is approx. 3' by 3' hanging beneath a helicopter.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: Contestants will crawl down rope nets hanging from helicopters, collect flags before the floor fall out from under then, and ride motorcycles on a suspended beam.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: Contestants take part in death-defying, stomach-churning stunts. This time, it's a race against time in an exploding room and a snack of camel spiders.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: Three seasons' worth of highlights include body piercing, bull riding, a boat-to-boat crash; host Joe Rogan.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: Contestants take part in death-defying, stomach-churning stunts. This time, it's jumping between two suspended platforms, a spin at barbershop roulette, and an explosive container launch.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: Team Episode - Contestants will lock hands to traverse a high platform, pass around hagfish, and tight rope for victory.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: Couples Episode - Contestants must rescue their spouse from a sinking cage, and dumpster dive as a team.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: This Super Bowl Halftime episode featured six Playboy Playmates. The ladies would have to walk a tight rope stretching between two rooftops 10 stories high. As they crossed the rope, they would be able to use hanging ropes for support. The four ladies to complete this stunt the fastest would advance to the next round.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: Bridge Hang Contestants would have to hang from a trapeze bar jutting from the side of a high bridge. The two men and the two women to hang on the longest before falling would advance to the next round. The others would be eliminated.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: This special episode featured four contestants on Spring Break in Cancun competing for 50,000 pesos (around 5,000 in American dollars). Contestants would have to climb into a jacuzzi full of dead squid, remove their bathing suit bottoms, find another bathing suit bottom somewhere in the jacuzzi, and put it on. The three contestants to do this the fastest would advance to the next round.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: Contestants take part in death-defying, stomach-churning stunts. This time, it's escaping suspended cars and a conveyor belt challenge covered in tarantulas and crickets.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: Contestants will be standing on the platform that is suspended from a circular truss piece that has gymnastics rings hanging all the way around from the bottom. On "go", the contestants will make their way around the rings as fast as they can. Contestants will lick bugs off of dangling bug-covered ropes and transfer them onto a scale.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: Contestants take part in death-defying, stomach-churning stunts. This time, it's balancing on a fast-moving boat, facing scorpions upside down, and barreling through barricades in a flatbed truck.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: Bull Riding Contestants would each have to ride a 2,000-pound bull. The two men and the two women who stayed on their bulls the longest would advance to the next round. The others would be eliminated.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: In this couples stunt, two tightropes and two hand lines will be strung parallel of each other from windows of the Mandalay Bay Hotel. On each tightrope, small sandbags will be tied. On "go" each teammate must untie and toss their sandbag to their teammate on the opposite rope.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: In this couples stunt, each team is seated in the front of their own car. The drivers are blindfolded and the passengers must navigate for them. The male contestants head is placed through a hole cut into the bottom of a plexi-sewer pipe, his partner must rescue him by crawling into the pipe and reaching around his head to undo a combination lock.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: Contestants take part in death-defying, stomach-churning stunts. This time, it's being shot out of a cannon, going extreme dumpster diving, and dropping into a landing zone from a helicopter.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: Contestants will be tumbled under water, be sealed in body bags with bugs, and traverse a course in the downwash of a helicopter.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: Players willshimmy up poles, bob for gross objects in cheese and perform daring driving stunts.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: Contestants take part in death-defying, stomach-churning stunts. This time, it's a tag-team challenge atop moving cars and a Bates Motel themed escape.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: Contestants must leap back and forth ebtween boats, make wine out of worms, and straddle two moving trailers.

programme.title: Lidia Celebrates America
programme.desc: Join beloved chef and cookbook author Lidia Bastianich on a deeply personal culinary journey to four celebrations of independence, to share in the wonderful diversity of American culture and food.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen

From her days as a small child preparing to go to the market with her grandmother to searching for seasonal produce today, it has always been an adventure. Recipes in this episode include a Shrimp, Roasted Pepper and Olive Salad and a delicious vegetarian Eggplant Parmigiana Stacks.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Olive oil is an essential staple in every Italian home. It's the easiest way to add flavor to any soup, and Lidia shows you how when making Cannellini Bean and Lentil Soup. Olive oil is also used in desserts, and she makes Olive Oil Cake.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: A light version of chicken parmigiana; rice balls stuffed with sausage ragu; Lidia's traditional Bolognese sauce.

programme.title: Biblical Collectors Series

Could there be a formula hidden in the Book of Revelation? The answers are at once hopeful and frightening.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: With autumn fast approaching, Monty is preparing the borders for the change of seasons and looking ahead to spring. Adam Frost and Advolly Richmond visit a glorious historic garden in North Yorkshire - Scampston Hall.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: This time there's plenty to do to prepare for the season to come, and Monty Don is clearing out spent crops and mulching his asparagus. Joe Swift's been to visit keen gardeners, Wayne and Geraldine Hemingway, to see how they combine sustainability with their designer-style. Carol Klein's exploring the history of the rose at Coughton Court, one of our best rose gardens and Monty plants a new rose of his own. What happens when you have to downsize and leave your much-loved garden?

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty harvests his spuds and sows seeds for autumn veg. He also shows how to get plants for free by taking cuttings.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: At Longmeadow, Monty plans for next spring when he plants some early-flowering wildflowers and gives his recipes for the different compost mixes he uses to take successful cuttings. Nick Bailey continues his quest for the South African origins of some much-loved summer bulbs, and in the heart of London, meet a keen gardener who has filled her houseboat with ornamental and edible plants.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty propagates succulent plants, revisits his container vegetable garden, and gives advice on how to get a good crop of pumpkins. Adam looks a new garden at RHS Hyde Hall in Essex, and Rachel visits a garden of vibrant colours in Wiltshire.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty gets going in his vegetable garden sowing seeds for a bountiful summer and growing some more unusual vegetables as well as recommending varieties of summer bulbs to plant in spring. Plus, Mark Lane creates a floral celebration in a container.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Despite the slow awakening of the garden, there are still plenty of jobs to be getting on with and Monty begins to divide ornamental grasses, gives advice on what to do with containers which are past their best, plants up a colourful alpine trough and gives advice on what to sow now in the vegetable garden.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Celebrate the very best of spring gardening with Monty at Longmeadow, and visit the RHS Malvern Spring Festival to see 2018's hottest garden designs and the season's must-have plants. At Longmeadow, Monty plants herbaceous perennials for summer colour and gives advice on how to care for carnivorous plants, Frances Tophill catches up with the growing trend for greening up indoor spaces with houseplants, and meet the third finalist in the Every Space Counts competition.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty elevates his cottage garden borders by adding plants to give height and drama, and rejuvenates the design of the grass borders by adding evergreen plants grown from cuttings. Carol Klein's plant of the season is the delicate but easy to grow dog's tooth violet, Joe Swift travels to the Trelissick garden in Cornwall to meet a very special garden volunteer and Adam Frost returns to Leicestershire to monitor the progress of the new build garden.

programme.title: Monty Don's Spanish Gardens
programme.desc: Monty travels across Central Spain. He begins at the vast, imposing palace and garden of the Escorial before heading for Madrid, Toledo, other parts of Castile and finally Valencia.

programme.title: Monty Don's Spanish Gardens
programme.desc: Monty Don is in the south of Spain, visiting gardens that show how this part of the country has evolved thanks to influences from visitors and settlers from ancient to modern times.

programme.title: Monty Don's Spanish Gardens
programme.desc: Monty Don travels across northern Spain, visiting gardens across this vast and diverse landscape that changes from an Atlantic to a Mediterranean climate as he journeys from Galicia to Catalonia.

programme.title: Monty Don's British Gardens
programme.desc: Monty Don travels from the north-west coast of Scotland to the north-east coast of England, from historic reconstructions to modern re-inventions. He visits some of the most inhospitable places in the country and finds gardens that are flourishing.

programme.title: Monty Don's British Gardens
programme.desc: Monty travels across some of the country's landscapes, heading across the north of England to Northern Ireland. Here, Monty sees the ingenuity, passion and determination of British people to garden and create gardens, no matter what the canvas.

programme.title: Monty Don's British Gardens
programme.desc: Monty travels across the middle of the country, from Wales to Norfolk. He comes across gardens for gnomes, much-loved, well-tended allotments and extravagant gardens that bankrupted their owners.

programme.title: Monty Don's British Gardens
programme.desc: Monty Don explores the most densely populated part of the country, London and the home counties. He visits some of London's gardens, including a special one on a barge, as well as a beautifully restored garden close to where he grew up in Hampshire.

programme.title: Monty Don's British Gardens
programme.desc: Monty travels across the south-west of the country to visit some of Britain's most exotic gardens. On this journey, Monty also goes to some of the country's most historic gardens, as well as some challenging contemporary ones.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty sows rocket, harvests chillies and tomatoes, and demonstrates how to take semi-ripe cuttings. Frances Tophill meets a head gardener in south London who's started gardening sustainably.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: At Longmeadow Monty is planting bulbs in pots and around the garden for an explosion of spring colour. Carol Klein travels to Yorkshire where she has a close look at the enormous colour range and form of a late season perennial, the salvia. Mark Lane is in Oxfordshire looking at how ornamental grasses can be used in planting design to create exciting combinations.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: It's all about the maintenance this week at Longmeadow, as Monty cuts back and divides spring flowering plants. Joe Swift and Adam Frost meet up in Leicestershire to see how they can help a couple of novice gardeners turn a neglected area of their garden into a useable and useful space. Nick Bailey goes to Ham House in Richmond to see how they are coping with the ravages of box tree caterpillar and Arit Anderson visits a garden in Suffolk to find out about the concept of rewilding.

programme.title: Monty Don's Japanese Gardens
programme.desc: Monty continues his travels to learn about the art of Japanese stonemasonry and the famous tea ceremonies and their accompanying gardens, before finally taking a lesson in the delicate art of traditional flower arranging.

programme.title: Monty Don's Japanese Gardens
programme.desc: Monty Don returns to Japan during the fiery blaze of autumn. He visits the three great gardens of Japan to learn how they protect the garden from the coming winter and learns how the Japanese are weaving nature into their concrete urban jungle.

programme.title: Monty Don's Italian Gardens
programme.desc: Monty Don conducts a personal grand tour around Italy's magnificent gardens from the luxurious retreats of the moneyed north to the lavish hideaways of the romantic south. In this episode, he's in and around Rome, a power base of emperors and popes, to explore gardens that are among some of the most extravagant and flamboyant ever created in history.

programme.title: Monty Don's Italian Gardens
programme.desc: Monty Don is on a grand tour around Italy, this time visiting gardens both in Florence and around the sun-scorched Tuscan countryside. Monty discovers how, like a piece of sculpture, renaissance gardens were created as works of art, and how a group of Edwardian ex-pats mistakenly reinforced the idea that formal Italian gardens were flowerless.

programme.title: Monty Don's Italian Gardens
programme.desc: Monty Don continues his grand garden tour of Italy. This time he is in Naples to visit some of the most sublime, romantic retreats in southern Italy. After all the formality of the green gardens around Rome and Florence, Monty seeks out idyllic horticultural gems set against the dramatic scenery of the Amalfi Coast to discover why, in the south, gardens are informal and, above all, filled with flowers.

programme.title: Monty Don's Italian Gardens
programme.desc: Monty Don concludes his garden tour of Italy in the wealthy north where, in the Veneto and Lucca, extravagant pleasure gardens were created for flirtation and fun. In the Lakes, Monty meets up with the garden society, the Grandi Giardini Italiani, to peer over the fence at luxurious creations of the rich and famous. The journey ends on Lake Maggiore to see the most theatrical horticultural gem of Italy.
programme.sub-title: The Veneto, Lucca and The Lakes

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: An old friend of Lucas McCain's, a traveling photographer, comes to North Fork plying his trade. When a murder is committed, the photographer is accused of the crime.

programme.title: Lion - Africa's Super Power
programme.desc: The endless plains of East Africa is a paradise for lions. The most social of all cats, lions form prides that are unlike any other animals. Together, they'll hunt, raise their young and defend their territory. With such a close family and plentiful home, the pride welcomes new babies every year. But new children introduces new dangers.

programme.title: Meet the Marsupials
programme.desc: Few countries have a more iconic representative in the animal kingdom than Australia and the marsupial. Once marsupials were found across the planet, but over time they found their way to the outback, leaving Australia as an ark carrying the future of pouch mammals. As varied as they are unusual, marsupials are a weird and wonderful mob of animals who carry their young in a pouch.

programme.title: Destination Wild - Wild Islands
programme.desc: The Falkland Islands' pristine coastlines and bountiful seas offer a lifeline and breeding centre for millions of penguins each year. Though while some find sanctuary on dry land, there's a daily battle to survive in the waters which surround these wild and rocky shores.

programme.title: Aquarium: An Aquatic Life
programme.desc: In the aftermath of Cape Towns biggest storm in 2 decades, there's a whole lot of work to be done at the Two Oceans Aquarium! The pressure builds as nine Ragged-Toothed Sharks are on their way from East London for their introduction to the new, highly anticipated predator exhibit. Join the team in one last push to complete the giant tank in time for its incoming residents and see the experience the culmination of a year of hard work coming together, at the Two Oceans Aquarium!

programme.title: Animals of the Bible
programme.desc: The bible is one of the most famous texts on earth. But it doesn't just concern humans, it also mentions animals - and some of these are probably not what you'd expect. We've all heard of the ox and the ass, the donkey that carried Mary, but did you know gazelles are mentioned in the bible? Or that great whales, cunning leopards and even the energetic hyrax feature?

programme.title: World's Wildest City: Anchorage
programme.desc: Anchorage is home to hundreds of black bears. And it's these black bears, that are patrolling the city. With their brains, their brawn and their cunning, these bears have mastered life in this urban jungle. When Spring arrives the bears hit the city as it's time to start eating. And these bears have found a source of food that is much easier to catch than a slippery salmon - it's trash. And it is everywhere. The city's bins and dumpsters have become the perfect bear restaurant.

programme.title: Costa Rica: The Rise of Nature
programme.desc: The tropical rainforests of Costa Rica provide an invaluable habitat to several emblematic species, such as jaguars, tapirs, white-lipped peccaries, spider monkeys, the very rear green macaw, amongst many others. Most of them are protected in national parks, reserves and wildlife refuges. However, the long-term survival of these ecosystems and of their biodiversity rely on the success of connecting wildlife populations throughout the country.

programme.title: Migrations - Herds on the Move
programme.desc: Whether driven by the search for food or the simple will to survive, great herd migrations are some of the most spectacular events of the natural world.

programme.title: Aging in the Wild
programme.desc: Aldabra Tortoise, Matriarch Elephants, Kittiwakes, Honey Bees, Hydra, Lions In this episode of Aging in the Wild, we explore the physiological secrets and factors that determine life expectancy in various animal species. From the seventy-year-old elephant to the quasi-immortal hydra, and the more than a hundred-year-old tortoise, we explore life expectancy, longevity and senescence. Can we distinguish between the effects of the environment and the internal adaptations that lead to longevity?

programme.title: World of the Wild
programme.desc: It might look uniform from the air, as we fly over it, but the oceans are deep and varied. The underwater landscape is made up of continental shelves, volcanoes, mountains, valleys, trenches and large, flat plains similar to the landscape on land only on a much larger scale. Ocean habitats come in all forms. Under water creatures make homes wherever survival is assured.

programme.title: World of the Wild
programme.desc: Large areas of water, broken up by small islands. Massive vegetation. Swamps, wetlands, marshes, bogs and fens are found all over the world, generally in more temperate regions where there is fast vegetation growth. Many of the larger animals that inhabit swamps and wetlands have a fish-based diet. LARGE CRABS dwell in the salt-water swamps, along with SNAPPING TURTLES and even CROCODILES AND ALLIGATORS. LIZARDS AND AMPHIBIANS live in and around the water's edge.

programme.title: World of the Wild
programme.desc: Deserts - dry, arid landscapes, environments of intense sun, heat and very little rain. The desert is extreme. An extre-me climate and an extreme environment where wild life has had to adapt to survive. Many of the animals that live in deserts have adopted a nocturnal lifestyle, surfacing only at night when it is cooler.

programme.title: World of the Wild
programme.desc: The masters of the sky are the winged predators of the aerial world. Whether swooping from altitude at phenomenal speed to strike an unsuspecting target from above, flicking and darting between trees in a lethal tail chase, or ghos-ting silently through the night in pursuit of prey, they excite our admiration and inspire awe in equal measure. All are superbly adapted to hunting and masters of their position at the top of the food chain.

programme.title: Aging in the Wild
programme.desc: Bighorn Sheep, Elk, Male Elephants, Marmots, Baboons, Rhinos Observing two massive elk clashing their antlers is to witness a true demonstration of power. For other species, such as the European marmot, remaining in power is a matter of collaborating with family and community. Are these animals forced to give up their hard-won social status as they age? Through this lens, we take a deep and entertaining look at the challenges faced by those in power ... and what it takes to stay there.

programme.title: Nuts About Squirrels
programme.desc: Even in our most urban settings, pretty much all of us know squirrels. They can be divisive charac-ters; some people adore them, offering them food, while others see them as glorified rats. But we can all agree that these are speedy, quirky, and exceptional characters. They also go crazy for nuts. They've conquered most of the globe, from icy tundra to the hottest deserts, developing ingen-ious life skills along the way, from stashing nuts to fighting snakes.

programme.title: Lions Rule
programme.desc: The Lion, Africa's ultimate predator. An essay in power and agility, famed for the cut-throat gang and the killer instinct. Lions are known as the kings of the jungle yet their homeland is an open grassland rather than rainforest. In the African plains prey-rich real estate can be hard to come by, and lions work together to ensure no one claims their territory and usurps their crown.

programme.title: Aging in the Wild
programme.desc: Lions, Chimpanzees, Turtles, Roe Deer, Gannets Reproduction is not only a concern of the young and restless: this episode of Aging in the Wild brings a light-hearted look at the issue of sexuality and camaraderie in older animals. We illustrate, for example, the link between the age of an elephant and its reproductive success. What are the reproductive benefits of these animals as they grow older?

programme.title: Wildest Islands
programme.desc: Lying like a teardrop in the Indian Ocean, Sri Lanka is an island that defies convention. Poised just six degrees above the equator, it's less than 75,000 km sq in size. But it has enough wildlife to rival a continent, and it's all down to its complicated climate and geography.

programme.title: World's Wildest City: Anchorage
programme.desc: In Anchorage, one bird rules the roost...the Bald Eagle. Expert hunters, they are perfectly adapted to life in tough arctic conditions, but in Anchorage, the secret to their survival... is trash. Every day, hundreds of bald eagles gather at the city dump, dodging trucks, machinery, and even pyrotechnics, in search of an easy meal. But this city life also brings constant danger, for the eagles themselves, and also for the human residents.

programme.title: World's Wildest City: Anchorage
programme.desc: One of Alaska's most secretive and efficient predators, Lynx are usually highly elusive... but in Anchorage, houses are being built in the Lynx's territory, forcing these usually shy big cats, to find new ways to survive on the streets. As this urban jungle continues to expand into the wilderness, encounters between people and wild Lynx are on the rise. In this wild city, can people live side by side with Alaska's deadliest big cat?

programme.title: Migrations - Frequent Flyers
programme.desc: Migration is one of the most remarkable phenomena of the natural world, and perhaps the most impressive migrants of all travel on the wing.

programme.title: Owls - Masters of the Night
programme.desc: Owls are mysterious creatures, living in a twilight world that we can rarely visit. Many cultures, including the Romans, Mayans and Aztecs, saw owls as something to fear, symbols of bad luck and impending doom. In reality owls are highly resourceful birds that have carved out a niche and a unique way to live. They range in size from smaller than a pigeon to as large as an eagle. They've colonised terrains from tundra to rainforest.

programme.title: Destination Wild - Desert Lands of the Middle East
programme.desc: Turkey sits on a jumbled collection of tectonic plates, whose collisions have created a tortuous landscape. In fact 80% of Turkeys terrain is rough, broken and mountainous. Mountain ranges both collect and block weather systems, affecting the climate across the country and producing huge contrasts between and within differing habitats.

programme.title: Wild Uruguay
programme.desc: Uruguay's biodiversity is surprisingly greater than one would expect. We will find out why as we embark on a journey through its ecosystems and landscapes to discover its fauna. Today we know that Uruguay is more than just the outermost edge of the Pampas, as the country holds a range of ecosystems. Within its borders, species of the Pampas come face to face with species of the Atlantic Forest, the Misiones rainforest, and the Chaco forest, giving rise to unexpected encounters.

programme.title: The Enchanted Forest
programme.desc: To spend a day in the forest, from dawn to dusk, is to bathe in nature. There's enchantment at every turn. Throughout the day the cast of characters in the forest changes, from foraging bears to playing fox cubs, dashing hummingbirds and dancing butterflies. But it's as twilight descends, that the most enchanting side of the forest is revealed. Time to watch a firework display curtesy of fireflies. They are the real magicians of the enchanted forest.

programme.title: Cost of Progress
programme.desc: The natural world is in crisis. For years humanity has exploited the planet's resources, and the creatures that live here. Growth and innovation can be a marvelous thing, but at what cost to our one and only planet? When we continue to push ahead blindly, it's more often than not Mother Nature that pays the price. Now it is time for us to rally - to take heed and start to turn back the tide. It's time for us to recognize our part in this crisis and redress the balance of the cost of progress.

programme.title: Destination Wild - Wild Europe
programme.desc: Over the last million years, our planet suffered a series of major ice-ages. Much of the northern hemisphere was covered in ice sheets several kilometres thick and creatures had no choice but to adapt or die. Over time, temperatures rose, causing these glaciers to retreat, however, in certain parts of Europe the ice-age never left. For many creatures, the struggle to survive 'a life below zero' continues.

programme.title: World's Wildest City: Anchorage
programme.desc: This city spends most of the year encased in ice...but when summer hits, Anchorage bursts into life. Animals and plants living this far north have been forced to adapt, working faster to make the most of the short season, but these animals built to withstand Alaska's extreme winters, often struggle in Anchorage's summer heat! Temperatures can be surprisingly high, with average July highs of 26 degrees C. 300,000 people live alongside these wild animals in the ever growing city of Anchorage.

programme.title: Creepy Crawlies - Army
programme.desc: Few creatures have the complex levels of regimented society as the social insects; these creatures understand that the strength of the individual is nothing compared with the combined power of the group. Creepy crawlies can form armies to help them build elaborate homes, raise their young and hunt their prey. These incredible communities both plagues our nightmares and fuels our imaginations. Society is considered the realm of higher beings, but hidden amongst the foliage, an army is rising.

programme.title: Aging in the Wild
programme.desc: Grizzly Bears, Orcas, Elephants, Wolves, Olive Baboons In many human cultures, elders play a vital role in the well-being of communities and are responsible for passing down knowledge and culture. Is it any wonder to find that the orca, the elephant, and the wolf, have been found to transmit their respective cultures to the younger generations? Young animals learn by observing their elders.

programme.title: Our Big Blue Backyard
programme.desc: The top of New Zealand's South Island is a landscape of two halves. To the West, one of the longest natural sandbars on the planet curves protectively around Golden Bay. To the East, mountains sink into the sea, their drowned river valleys forming the Marlborough Sounds. Turbulent currents connect them, both treacherous and full of riches.
programme.sub-title: Top of the South/ Te Tau Ihu

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: The site of the bloodiest battle of the Revolutionary War sets the stage for an unforgettable investigation by TAPS. For decades, residents and visitors of Thornbury Farm have experienced horrifying events including the voice of a moaning child and the apparition of a soldier with a bloody limb. The team's overnight investigation yields shocking findings, including direct contact with a paranormal presence.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS calls in Bruce Tango, father of Dave Tango, to help investigate a place close to his heart, the Union County Courthouse, a historic property in Elizabeth, NJ, Over the years, many staff members have reported phones ringing without anyone on the lines and seeing apparitions roaming the halls who is known to be of Hannah Coldwell or the four men who died at the hands of capital punishment, who haunt the halls of these historic building.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS has received an urgent call for help from a Chicago community center whose patrons are being chased away by a variety of menacing spirits. The Benton House is a historic set of two buildings that have served the city of Chicago for a century. Through the years, a number of residents have expired on the property from devastating illness.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: This week TAPS heads to Thousand Island, NY to investigate a 4-acre private island and is joined by the " King of Rock and Roll" himself, Meatloaf. The 4-acre private island owned by the Claudia family houses a four-story, ten-bedroom mansion and a three-story, seven-bedroom boathouse. The immediate family of six resides in the boathouse while the mansion serves as guest quarters for visitors. The property has been in the family for fifty years and has always had a haunted history.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS heads to Quincy, Massachusetts to investigate the unexplainable paranormal events that are haunting a 716 foot long ship. The USS Salem spent decades sailing the oceans of the world as a witness to untold death and damage. In 1953, a large earthquake struck the Ionian Islands in Greece, completely devastating the communities and killing hundreds. The USS Salem was the first American ship to arrive on the scene and provided relief supplies and assistance.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: This week, TAPS is called in to investigate the Fort Henry, where it once served as a cornerstone for Canada's military defense and execution site. Today, Fort Henry is considered by many to be the most haunted place in Canada. One frequently reported incident involves a male apparition seen wandering around the exterior and interiors of the fortress.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS heads to Chicago Illinois to investigate a Chicago landmark for nearly a century, the Congress Theater. Built in 1926, the massive building's original Italian Renaissance architecture remains mostly preserved. The Congress has transitioned through the decades of Chicago history and exists today as a renowned live concert venue. According to many present and past employees, there is also something undeniably paranormal present at the theater.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: This week TAPS answers the Wrights begging call heads to Manitou Springs, Colorado to investigate the Briarhurst Manor located at the base of Pike's Peak. The property was built in 1888 by Englishman William Bell and has had about 20 owners throughout the years. The property was made into apartment buildings in the early 70's and then became a restaurant now owned by Ken Healey. One of the prior owners Mrs.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: The TAPS team has been called to wrangle some ghosts that seem to be haunting the resting place of Buffalo Bill. The museum staff has asked the TAPS team to help them figure out if the old cowboy has made this site his final rest stop. Cody died in Denver in 1917 and his final request was to be buried on Lookout Mountain with views of the mountains and plains where he spent most of his life.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: The TAPS team heads to New Hampshire to help a group of volunteers figure out what is causing the lively paranormal activity in their otherwise quiet museum. The Amos J. Blake House was originally built in 1837 as a commercial building that was used for both business and to house tenants. Several deaths have occurred in the house, mostly children, before the turn of the 20th century. Amos J. Blake moved into the house with his wife Lizzie in the 1860's.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS heads to the Florida Panhandle to investigate a notoriously haunted lighthouse with over a century's worth of paranormal reports. Located on the Pensacola Naval Air Station, home of the Blue Angels, the Lighthouse stands 160 feet above Pensacola Bay and the Florida Gulf Coast. The beacon ranges in diameter from 30 feet at the base to 15 feet at the top and is total of 177 steps.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS is called to the former home of one of the world's most famous authors in order to investigate a series of startling paranormal occurrences. Mark Twain and his family occupied this architecturally unique house for nearly 20 years. After his daughter died in the home, Twain and his family abandoned the property. Today, the curators of the house are plagued with an array of strange sights and sounds.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: This week, TAPS takes a call from the American Legion in Pennsylvania where people are terrified by paranormals. The building was established in the 1700s and was once rented out as apartments. The current owners have had the property since 1974 and are convinced that the place is haunted, so TAPS heads in to find out. Jason and Grant begin the hunt on the third floor where the current owner says she's too afraid to go.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: In the exciting season finale, TAPS travels to the site where Hindenburg, one of history's most infamous disasters, took place. The Hindenburg was a German airship filled with hydrogen for buoyancy. In 1937, while trying to dock at the Lakehurst Naval base, it caught fire and killed 36 people. The entire ordeal was caught on film and is still one of the most famous tragedies that have ever been reported.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: For the 100th episode of Ghost Hunters, the team is allowed private access to Alcatraz Island, a dream come true for paranormal teams. From a two day prison revolt in 1946 known as the Battle of Alcatraz that occurred, people say they can still hear gun fire and crying. In Cell Block D, otherwise known as solitary confinement, there is a report of a run in with a spirit. Other activity reported is that of an apparition of a prisoner with glaring red eyes, and the sound of screams.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: Fort Ticonderoga, located in upstate New York, is being haunted by the dead from three nations and needs help from the TAPS team. The fort was built in 1755 by the French army, and would be witness to several bloody battles over the next two decades. The British army suffered 2,000 casualties; it was the most devastating battle on American soil until the Civil War. Due largely to the amount of violence and death that took place, there is lots of paranormal activity reported.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, the TAPS team has been asked to go to Paddy Reilly's Bar in Manhattan, New York to help explain some after hours activity. Dark shadows have been seen in the basement, voices have been heard, glasses are known to move on their own, and bottles break for no apparent reason. In an upstairs apartment, three men saw an apparition riding a bike, and across the hall a tenant saw a man resembling Gene Hackman peering through a window.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, the TAPS team visits the Absecon Lighthouse in Atlantic City, NJ. This lighthouse has activity reported ranging from untraceable footsteps and doors opening spontaneously, to coughing coming from the keeper's quarters. In the lighthouse itself, people have reported smelling cigar smoke, hearing voices and laughter, and even seeing a persons hand.Jason and Grant start out in the tower, where they hear a possible conversation and footsteps.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads to The Southern Mansion in Cape May, NJ, and have enlisted the help of Dave Tango's father, Bruce. Bruce has experienced first hand some of the reported activity here; some of it includes glasses dissolving into sand, people being grabbed, a soldier walking through walls, a soldier talking with a woman, and the smell of gardenias. It is believed that the ghost woman could possibly be the niece of the original owner, Esther.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters the TAPS team investigates Preston Castle, a once notorious reform school for boys in Northern California. People have seen apparitions of a man in a white coat in the doctor's office. The infirmary seems to be haunted by a boy that was shot while trying to escape the school. Upstairs there are claims of humming noises, groups of voices, a mist and a woman who claims she was pinched on the butt.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS has been called to the Grzelak house in Massachusetts where they have been experiencing paranormal activity since the day they moved in 30 years ago. A series of apparitions, shadow people, mysterious voices and even physical attacks have left the Grzelaks desperate for help, to the point where they want to move.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS is called to Cape Cod to investigate the Orleans Inn. Some of the claims here are that candles light on their own, glasses slide off tables, hauntings by two separate men who hung themselves, doors opening and closing, and ghosts of naked women. Despite all this, the strangest claim comes from Room 5, where two separate guests have checked in and been driven to insanity inside the room.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS visits the home of the Scully family, who are so terrified they are ready to pack up and move. Some of the activities reported in the house are confrontational shadows, spirits breathing down people's necks and, adult legs walking up the stairs. The greatest activity is in the 4-year-old son's bedroom, where he spends his time with the spirits of 2 small children, and talks to them as well as about them.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS becomes the first paranormal team to be invited to investigate Norwich State Hospital, in Norwich, Connecticut. There have been lots of rumors of activity, including moving shadows, haunting faces, screams, moans, and apparitions of children. Excited to start investigating, Jason and Grant start out in the research building and right away they see a moving shadow followed by a strange noise, and faint light in the stairway.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS drives to the Otesaga Resort Hotel in Cooperstown, NY. Employees are terrified by voices calling out to them and doors swinging all on their own. Guests in the hotel also hear non-existent children running the halls and furniture being dragged across the floor upstairs (even on the top floor), while shadows and orbs have been seen and moaning has been heard. Jason and Grant start out in the ballroom, and try to debunk the claim of an orb.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS has been asked to help the 1875 Inn in Tilton, New Hampshire. The Inn has had two major fires, one of which supposedly took the life of a child named Laura, who now haunts the hotel. One claim is that about 30 people saw a gargoyle-like creature suspended in the air. Another claim is hair being stroked, and there are numerous "Laura" encounters.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS visits the location of the "shot heard round the world" at the Colonial Inn in Concord, Massachusetts. Some of the reported activity includes shadowy figures, people being touched, objects flying off the shelf, and power surges. The history goes all the way back to 1775, when wounded soldiers from the Battle of Concord were brought to the site for medical attention.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, the TAPS team is on Rose Island to investigate their haunted lighthouse. This island housed cholera victims exiled from Newport, and many of the sick never returned to the mainland. From inside the quarantine room of the barracks, people have heard voices or felt uneasy.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, the TAPS team is invited to Lemp Mansion in St. Louis, Missouri. There have been tragic deaths at this mansion with the patriarch and three of his children taking their own lives. There are reported feelings of uneasiness in 'the office,' which is where William Lemp committed suicide. The bar area was once the bedroom of Charles Lemp, who killed his dog and then himself it's said that people see him walking around with his dog at his side.

programme.title: Criminal
programme.desc: CIA agent Bill Pope (Ryan Reynolds) dies while traveling to a secret location to meet a hacker who can launch missiles at will. Desperate to find his whereabouts, officials turn to an experimental neurosurgeon who can transfer memories from one brain to another. The guinea pig for the procedure is Jerico Stewart (Kevin Costner), a violent and dangerous death-row inmate. Now gifted with Pope's skills and knowledge, Stewart must race against time to stop a sinister international conspiracy.

programme.title: MI-5: The Greater Good
programme.desc: A former MI5 agent (Peter Firth) investigates the disappearance of Harry Pearce (Kit Harington) when the operative is blamed for the escape of a ruthless terrorist (Elyes Gabel).

programme.title: One Ranger
programme.desc: Recruited by British intelligence, a Texas Ranger must track down and stop a dangerous terrorist from attacking London.

programme.title: Destroyer
programme.desc: As a young cop, Erin Bell went undercover to infiltrate a gang in the California desert -- with tragic results. Bell continues to work as a detective for the Los Angeles Police Department, but feelings of anger and remorse leave her worn-down and consumed by guilt. When the leader of that gang suddenly re-emerges, Erin embarks on an obsessive quest to find his former associates, bring him to justice and make peace with her tortured past.

programme.title: Detective Knight: Rogue
programme.desc: Mask-wearing robbers critically wound Detective James Knight's partner during a shootout. As Knight pursues the bandits from Los Angeles to New York, his dark past collides with his present case, threatening to tear his world apart.

programme.title: Detective Knight: Redemption
programme.desc: In custody in New York, Detective James Knight finds himself in the middle of a jailbreak led by The Christmas Bomber, a brutal fanatic whose Santa Claus disciples are terrorizing the city.

programme.title: Showdown at the Grand
programme.desc: A movie theater owner must defend his family business from corporate developers alongside a legendary action star as art imitates life in a showdown for the ages.

programme.title: Suburbia
programme.desc: An overwhelming sense of despair impels a teenager to leave his suburban home and join up with a group of punk rockers.

programme.title: City on Fire
programme.desc: An undercover cop (Chow Yun-Fat) infiltrates a gang of jewel thieves, but things go terribly wrong during a heist.

programme.title: Rough Magic
programme.desc: In the midst of a dazzling stage show, magician's assistant Myra Shumway (Bridget Fonda) catches the eye of sleazy industrialist Cliff Wyatt (D.W. Moffett). When Wyatt unwittingly kills Shumway's mentor, a master magician, she flees to Mexico. Furious, Wyatt hires private detective Alex Ross (Russell Crowe) to capture the gorgeous witness to his crime. But, after Ross locates Shumway, he finds himself beguiled by her growing prowess as a magician -- and by the potency of her feminine charms.

programme.title: Slacker
programme.desc: Austin, Texas, is an Eden for the young and unambitious, from the enthusiastically eccentric to the dangerously apathetic. Here, the nobly lazy can eschew responsibility in favor of nursing their esoteric obsessions. The locals include a backseat philosopher (Richard Linklater) who passionately expounds on his dream theories to a seemingly comatose cabbie (Rudy Basquez), a young woman who tries to hawk Madonna's Pap test to anyone who will listen and a kindly old anarchist looking for recruits.

programme.title: Nosferatu the Vampyre
programme.desc: Jonathan Harker is sent away to Count Dracula's castle to sell him a house in Virna, where he lives. But Count Dracula is a vampire, an undead ghoul living off men's blood. Inspired by a photograph of Lucy Harker, Jonathan's wife, Dracula moves to Virna, bringing with him death and plague... An unusually contemplative version of Dracula, in which the vampire bears the cross of not being able to get old and die.

programme.title: Fist of Legend
programme.desc: Chinese martial arts student Chen Zhen is studying in Kyoto, Japan, when he learns his mentor has died in a match against Ryuichi Akutagawa. Returning home to the Japanese-occupied Shanghai of 1937, Chen challenges Ryuichi to a fight and easily defeats him. Concluding his master was set up, Chen has an autopsy performed. Meanwhile, word of his martial arts skill entices new students hoping to study with him, making his teacher's son, Huo Ting-An, jealous.

programme.title: Fast Vengeance
programme.desc: Determined to find those responsible for his brother's death, a man infiltrates the dangerous and high-stakes world of underground motorcycle racing.

programme.title: Take Back
programme.desc: A woman embarks on a vengeful quest to save her kidnapped daughter from a mysterious man from her past.

programme.title: College
programme.desc: Brilliant in his studies and dismissive of athletics, Ronald (Buster Keaton) finishes high school at the top of his class. But in college his uptight attitude doesn't win him any points with his sports-loving classmates, and pretty coed Mary (Anne Cornwall) ignores him in favor of brutish jock Jeff (Harold Goodwin). Hoping to impress Mary, Ronald makes a buffoon of himself at every sport imaginable, usually at Jeff's hand. But Ronald gets a final shot at glory in a big rowing race.

programme.title: Prison on Fire
programme.desc: Yiu (Tony Leung Ka Fai) is a young advertising executive in Hong Kong. One night, defending his father from attack, he accidentally shoves a street thug in front of a bus. Sentenced to three years in prison, Yiu is "fresh meat" for the hardened criminals and triad stooges that run things, and is preyed upon by sadistic guard Scarface (Roy Cheung). The virtuous Ching (Chow Yun-Fat) intervenes, teaching him the ropes of prison life, and a tender friendship develops between the two.

programme.title: Beauty and the Beast
programme.desc: A romance blossoms between the youngest daughter of a merchant who has fallen on hard times and the mysterious beast her father owes a debt to.

programme.title: Skyline
programme.desc: Jarrod (Eric Balfour) and Elaine (Scottie Thompson) take a trip to Southern California to visit his friend, Terry (Donald Faison), for a fun getaway, but it turns into a weekend of terror. During the night a cluster of strange, mesmerizing lights signals the arrival of an alien invasion. As thousands of terrified people are pulled into the maws of giant alien ships, Jarrod and his companions must use every skill they have to survive global genocide.

programme.title: Galaxy of Terror
programme.desc: Neurotic astronauts (Edward Albert, Erin Moran, Ray Walston) face a giant worm and other monsters on a distant planet.

programme.title: Eyes Without a Face
programme.desc: Dr. Génessier (Pierre Brasseur) is riddled with guilt after an accident that he caused disfigures the face of his daughter, the once beautiful Christiane (Edith Scob), who outsiders believe is dead. Dr. Génessier, along with accomplice and laboratory assistant Louise (Alida Valli), kidnaps young women and brings them to the Génessier mansion. After rendering his victims unconscious, Dr. Génessier removes their faces and attempts to graft them on to Christiane's.

programme.title: Heathers
programme.desc: Veronica (Winona Ryder) is part of the most popular clique at her high school, but she disapproves of the other girls' cruel behavior. When Veronica and her new boyfriend, J.D. (Christian Slater), confront clique leader Heather Chandler (Kim Walker) and accidentally poison her, they make it appear a suicide. Soon Veronica realizes that J.D. is intentionally killing students he does not like. She races to stop J.D. while also clashing with the clique's new leader, Heather Duke (Shannen Doherty).

programme.title: Face the Nation
programme.desc: "Face the Nation," which is one of the longest-running news programs on the air, offers insight and analysis on the top issues of the day. Moderator Margaret Brennan welcomes politicians, government leaders and international newsmakers to a roundtable discussion of current events with CBS News correspondents.

programme.title: 60 Minutes
programme.desc: The oldest and most-watched newsmagazine on television gets the real story on America's most prevalent issues. CBS News correspondents contribute segments to each hourlong episode. Topics range from hard news coverage to politics, lifestyle, pop culture, business, health, and science. The correspondents and contributors include Lesley Stahl, Scott Pelley, Anderson Cooper, Bill Whitaker, Sharyn Alfonsi, Jon Wertheim and Norah O'Donnell .

programme.title: Engine Power
programme.desc: Our famous Turbo Ford 300 makes its return in Part 2 of our ultimate dream build. A custom front accessory drive and EFI system follow as we get this engine ready for big power on the engine dyno.

programme.title: Detroit Muscle
programme.desc: Our 1971 Chevy Caprice, Project Fat Stack, ROARS to life after almost a year of work. Tommy and Peyton give the nitty gritty on exhaust installation and finish the interior. Fat Stack turns heads in downtown Nashville to the delight of the Broadway crowd.
programme.sub-title: Fat Stack - Part 14: Clean, Mean, and Candy Green

programme.title: Music City Trucks
programme.desc: It's time to mock everything in place in our 1974 Bronco. We'll also have the frame blasted and powder coated, the body in epoxy, and assembled to the frame.

programme.title: Detroit Muscle
programme.desc: Rust Revival - Brian and Joel are back in the shop with their sleeves rolled up and ready to bust the rust in their Chevy 210, Project Shell Shock. Watch as they cut, fit, and weld fresh floor pans into place, to help give this classic a solid foundation inside and out. Then it's full steam ahead as the guys strip Shell Shock down to bare metal, prepping every inch for a new paint job.
