programme.title: The Big Attack: Combat Heroes of WWII
programme.desc: Nothing prepares soldiers to be surrounded by enemy tanks and infantry. When tasked with defending a recently captured town in Bastogne, Belgium, Joe's aging platoon awoke to find themselves surrounded, outnumbered and outgunned. His platoon dumbfounded; Private Joseph Richardson took matters into his own hands. Grasping a bazooka Joe sought to break up the German counterattack.

programme.title: Battlezone: The Korean War
programme.desc: In Korea, the aggressor's challenge was met and turned back by the United Forces of the world's free nations. Yet in the backwash of war there always remains a second challenge -- the thousands of orphans, the millions of homeless, the countless villages and cities ravaged and almost completely destroyed. Our cameras focus on one such city, Seoul, the Capital of the Republic of Korea.

programme.title: The Big Attack: Combat Heroes of WWII
programme.desc: On the brink of failure, many give up but some fight twice as hard. Establishing a military academy in Munich, the Seventh Army trained non-commissioned officers. One of these students, Sgt. Leon Carroll had, to this point, received twenty demerits. He mobilized all his intelligence and leadership to complete his course avoiding the final demerit which would result in discharge.

programme.title: Architects of Darkness
programme.desc: The Occult Roots of the Third Reich. The creator of the infamous Gestapo, the Waffen SS and the concentration camp network. Perhaps the strangest individual of all the Nazi crew. Himmler was inspired by mystic visions, runes, horoscopes and a longing for a heroic German past.

programme.title: Visions of War: U.S. Marines
programme.desc: Marines clean machine guns and attend religious services aboard transports at sea, climb into landing craft which head for shore, wade through the surf protected by naval, and aerial bombardment, consolidate beach positions, move inland, and care for wounded. Mortars are fired and Japanese infantry flushed from dugouts. Japanese POW's are searched and given first aid.

programme.title: Anzac Battlefields: The Western Front
programme.desc: Monash takes up the challenge of vigorous pursuit of the Germans and in one day advance 10 kilometres and takes two and a half thousand prisoners - one week later the war is over.

programme.title: WWII: The Road To Victory
programme.desc: The victories at Manila and Okinawa are discussed.

programme.title: The Attackers
programme.desc: In this episode, the pilots of a Soviet aviation regiment face challenges during World War II. They engage in combat, search for a downed German pilot, and receive a new recruit. The episode explores the camaraderie and determination of the pilots in the face of adversity.

programme.title: The Crusade in the Pacific
programme.desc: Crusade in the Pacific looks at U.S. involvement in the the Pacific theater starting in 1933. It looks at Pearl Harbor, the Burma theater, the Battle of the Coral Sea, the Battle of Midway, the invasion of Iwo Jima and Okinawa, the dropping of the atomic bomb and the surrender of Japan. It also looks at the start of the Korean War.

programme.title: The Attackers
programme.desc: At an airfield, Ivan, a new recruit, meets Lyudmila, a skilled pilot concealing an ailment. She mentors him as Lenya, the strict trainer, pushes Martynov, a rebellious trainee. When scouts go missing, aerial battles ensue, forging deep bonds, and unveiling secrets. Amidst peril and personal struggles, they find courage, love, and hope.

programme.title: WWII: The Road To Victory
programme.desc: Outstanding military Naval leaders, soldiers, sailors, and marines are discussed and the Theater commanders of General Dwight D. Eisenhower are also discussed.

programme.title: Hitler's Eastern Front: Army Group North
programme.desc: As Europe staggered toward war, Stalin saw opportunity to gain territory for Russia and stand apart from imperialist conflict between Britain, France and Germany. He abandoned cooperation from western pals. By agreeing to share polish territory between the 3rd Reich and the Soviet Union after invasion, Hitler kept the Russians at bay on his eastern borders to devote attention to war with the west.

programme.title: WWII: The Call of Duty
programme.desc: Hitler's position was worsening by the day, the Nazis were still capable of inflicting terrible damage. When the Germans attempted a breakthrough in the Ardennes region of France, the Battle of the Bulge resulted in large US casualties.

programme.title: WWII: The Call of Duty
programme.desc: While the Russians moved towards Germany from the East, and the allies attacked from the west, the Japanese continued their battle in the Pacific, fighting American Marines on Iwo Jima.

programme.title: WWII: The Road To Victory
programme.desc: The landings on the beaches of Normandy, the first step in the operation, codenamed Overlord enterprise by Dwight D. Eisenhower. The greatest amphibious invasion in history.

programme.title: Embedded 45' Shooting War in Germany
programme.desc: This first episode covers the last week of February to late March. When American troops started their final invasion of Nazi Germany in February 1945, U.S. Army cameramen were at their side. Over a thousand reels have been preserved; many of them untouched for decades. The cameramen covered many stories of victory and defeat, death and liberation. Faces of despair and joy, scenes of war and peace.

programme.title: World War I: Cause and Effects
programme.desc: The conflict that engulfed the world between 1914 and 1918 left an indelible mark on the 20th century and shaped the world in which we live today. Learn about the tumultuous events that led to World War I, the complex alliances, the Russian Revolution and the rise of communism, and much more. The complete story of the first modern war.

programme.title: Soviet Storm
programme.desc: Erich von Manstein's soldiers have trapped a massive Soviet force in Crimea, but the doomed troops have no intentions of surrendering, strongly motivated by patriotism. Manstein assembles the greatest concentration of artillery in history, which includes the world's biggest railway-gun nicknamed 'Dora,' and for eight months Soviets troops are savagely bombarded; destroying Sevastopol's only harbor.

programme.title: World of Warships Clash of Titans
programme.desc: In May 1905, after a year of stalemate in the Russo-Japanese War, Russia's Pacific squadron arrived at the Tsushima Strait. Admiral Togo's Japanese fleet of 88 ships ambushed them, resulting in a decisive battle. Nearly the entire Russian fleet was sunk or captured, sealing the fate of the Russian Empire and marking a turning point in naval warfare. Only a few Russian ships survived the encounter.

programme.title: Modern Warfare: Terrorism
programme.desc: The very nature of terrorism has changed. Suicide Bombings, Hijacking, violent attacks, and the taking of hostages has become the standard.

programme.title: D-Day: The Longest of Days
programme.desc: The aerial and amphibious assault on the beaches of Normandy and the allied convoys landing on the Normandy beaches. Shows Gens. Eisenhower and Montgomery and Adm. Sir Bertram Ramsey.

programme.title: The Big Attack: Combat Heroes of WWII
programme.desc: An American Intelligence Officer faces off against a brutal Russian Colonel in a tense story about the 'kidnapping' of fifteen German war orphans. Sheltered by a brave Baroness, the children's fate is threatened when V Day Armistice places her home in the Russian zone. U.S. Captain Tom Ryan and Sergeant Steve Maycheck, decide to rescue the orphans and the Baroness, leading to a thrilling climax.

programme.title: Hitler's Propaganda Machine
programme.desc: The decade of propaganda, impassioned speeches, newspaper articles, posters and campaigning that all led to one moment - Hitler being made Chancellor of Germany in January 1933.

programme.title: The Third Reich in Color
programme.desc: From 1937, colour films also document life in Hitler's Germany. Eva Braun and Hitler's pilot Hans Baur are among the first amateur filmmakers to expose the new celluloid. This creates unique images of the dictator's public appearances and his private life on Obersalzberg. Scanned in high-resolution HD, the footage of Hitler and his entourage unfolds a particularly realistic effect.

programme.title: Men Against Tanks
programme.desc: Made in 1943 in order to help motivate the hard pressed German infantry to resist the increasing tide of Soviet armor. It is a remarkable film in many respects as it features a dramatized and highly realistic record of a Soviet attack on the German lines by T-34 tanks and provides a detailed summary of the potential defenses which the infantryman could use to defend against Soviet tanks.

programme.title: The Life of Adolf Hitler: The Path to Dictatorship
programme.desc: How did Adolf Hitler come to create a regime, to hold the World in a grip of terror the likes of which had never been seen before?Hitler's rise from a rabble rouser on the streets of Bavaria to the pinnacle of power in Berlin and conquest of most of Western Europe, is one of the most extraordinary and savage stories of our time. Millions of Germans saw in him the Messiah he felt himself to be.

programme.title: Desert Generals
programme.desc: This is the story of a final showdown between two titans of war in uninhibited warfare without buildings, cities or populations. In 1942 The British Army was being pushed back towards Cairo at a rate of almost 100 miles a day. Within a week, Rommel would take Egypt. The allies would lose the Mediterranean, Asia, the Iraq oilfields and its nascent US ally.

programme.title: Embedded 45' Shooting War in Germany
programme.desc: This first episode covers the last week of February to late March. When American troops started their final invasion of Nazi Germany in February 1945, U.S. Army cameramen were at their side. Over a thousand reels have been preserved; many of them untouched for decades. The cameramen covered many stories of victory and defeat, death and liberation. Faces of despair and joy, scenes of war and peace.

programme.title: Battle for Warsaw
programme.desc: The tragic story of the 1944 Warsaw uprising against Nazi rule is chronicled with actual film of the epic event. With some shocking new footage unearthed from the vaults, this is an compelling guide to the events that unfolded. A variety of eyewitness accounts are drawn on, haunting depictions of mass graves, and troops storming into the beleaguered country.

programme.title: The Crusade in Europe
programme.desc: General Montgomery attacks Italy across the Strait of Messina. A landing is made at Salerno to coincide with Italy's surrender, after Italy's fleet surrenders at Malta.

programme.title: The US Battle For Supremacy In The Pacific
programme.desc: In 1943 John Ford gave the great cinematographer Gregg Toland (Citizen Kane, The Grapes of Wrath) an opportunity to direct his first film. A veritable epic, framed by a debate between Walter Huston's Uncle Sam and Harry Davenport's Mr. C on the true nature of the Pacific paradise, Pearl Harbor.

programme.title: The Crusade in the Pacific
programme.desc: This chapter presents the events that led to America's entry into World War II after the Japanese attack on Pearl Harbor on December 7, 1941. It also shows the early setbacks and losses suffered by the Allies in the Pacific Theater, such as the fall of Wake Island, Guam, the Philippines, Hong Kong, Malaya, and Indonesia.
programme.sub-title: America Goes to War in the Pacific

programme.title: World of Warships Clash of Titans
programme.desc: In April 1945, the Yamato, the largest battleship in history, left for Okinawa to destroy American warships and prevent their landing. Weighing 70,000 tonnes and armed with 150 guns, it faced the U.S. naval aviation, including aircraft carriers USS Essex and USS Yorktown. In a fierce battle, American pilots focused on one goal: sink the Yamato. This marked a turning point in WWII naval warfare.

programme.title: About Executing Eichmann
programme.desc: Jewish historians and thinkers dwell on the importance of Eichmann's trial in Israël's history and on the violent debates provoked by his death sentence in the 60's in the intellectual and political sphere.

programme.title: Sara's Weeknight Meals
programme.desc: Two of our favorite things come together in this episode - pasta and one pan meals. First, Slow Cooking expert Michele Scicolone shows us how to make a delicious Pork Ragu with Broken Lasagna in the slow cooker. Then Sara makes a Pearl Couscous with Shellfish, and explains what pans are essential to stock a kitchen.
programme.sub-title: Sara's Weeknight Meals - Pasta in a Pan

programme.title: Sara's Weeknight Meals
programme.desc: It's a stuffed pasta showdown as Sara travels to an ancient Tuscan villa to learn the secrets of homemade ravioli from a real Italian chef, a delicious but time-consuming task involving asparagus, goat cheese and a whole lot of chianti. Back home in her American kitchen, Sara shows us a hack to make a homemade ravioli stuffed with spicy greens, quick enough for a weeknight and pretty darn tasty. Which is best? Only the cook knows.
programme.sub-title: Sara's Weeknight Meals - BASTA PASTA: US VS ITALY

programme.title: Cooking with Nick Stellino
programme.desc: Chef Stellino reconnects with his Italian roots as he guides the viewer through some simple and exciting techniques on how to make traditional Italian pasta dishes with the elegance and panache of an Italian born chef, with a plateful of tips, techniques and ideas to help anyone improve their style and performance in the kitchen.
programme.sub-title: Cooking with Nick Stellino - It Is all about Pasta!

programme.title: Cooking with Nick Stellino
programme.desc: The most popular of all pasta sauces finally makes its appearance and chef Stellino is absolutely giddy as he joyfully shares with his viewers his favorite pasta dish from his youth. Simple, easy to follow techniques are at the heart of every success, and to celebrate our good fortune let's all make a fluffy zabaglione.
programme.sub-title: Cooking with Nick Stellino - Pasta with Bolognese Ragu and Strawberries with Zabaglione

programme.desc: Chef Stellino makes and plates his favorite pasta dishes.

programme.desc: Tangy gorgonzola cheese with crisp, red radicchio in creamy sauce with meltingly tender, stewed sweet red.

programme.desc: Food writer and book author Laura Schenone brings a unique Ligurian recipe to Mary Ann's kitchen, where together they prepare delicate pasta wafers called Corzetti served in a delicate garlic and olive oil sauce. Mary Ann adds to the fun with Panzoti, an almond-stuffed little ravioli swimming in a butter sauce. Bravissima Laura e Marianna, e bravissima Liguria!

programme.title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets
programme.desc: The CentralTirgus is the biggest covered city food market in Europe. Just aside the Art Nouveau Old Town, we find century-old rye-bread making, grilled lampreys, soviet milk sausages, and hemp butter. Here the best of Latvian traditions are pushed fast-forward into the digital era by young and curious chefs, bloggers, and pop-up restaurants.
programme.sub-title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets - In the Belly of Riga

programme.title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets
programme.desc: The old ladies selling their baskets full of vegetables and cheese on the Dolac market in Zagreb bring us back in time. At the market, we go from the breathtaking Mediterranean islands to the Austrian Alps, from freshly caught hake and simple Baltic snacks to internationally awarded cheese and a unique Turkey breed.
programme.sub-title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets - In the Belly of Zagreb

programme.title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets
programme.desc: At the Mercato Centrale in San Lorenzo, one can taste the best food treasures Tuscany has on offer: from the olive oil of the Fiesole hills to the onions of the medieval borough of Certaldo and up to the Natural Reserve of San Marcello with its Tuscan cured meats. Here the simple and genuine tastes are king.
programme.sub-title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets - In the Belly of Firenze

programme.title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets
programme.desc: The Viktualienmarkt developed from an original farmers' market to a popular market for gourmets. The market also hosts a number of traditional and folkloric events. But the center of the social life of the city is the world-famous Biergarten - here the seven historical breweries of the city pour the finest beers of the world.
programme.sub-title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets - In the Belly of Munich

programme.title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets
programme.desc: Placed in the middle of Palermo's ancient streets, it is almost difficult to walk. All around there is a swarm of colors and perfumes. There is everything the Mediterranean island, so rich in agricultural traditions, has to offer. Street food here is a must, including dozens of roasted, salted, pickled, and fried specialties one can count on.
programme.sub-title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets - In the Belly of Palermo

programme.title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets
programme.desc: Ireland's third-largest city has one of Northern Europe's market gems: The English Market. It supplies high-quality food to affluent English families unlike the Irish market, which no longer exists. The best Irish produce today remains on the island and can be found here.
programme.sub-title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets - In the Belly of Cork

programme.title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets
programme.desc: The Kapani market is situated just behind the Aristotelous square of the city of Thessaloniki, facing the Aegean Sea. Exploring this market is exploring the city and its history: a tasteful mix of Sephardic, Balkan, Turkish, and Greek delights. All can be found in the intricate streets of the market or tasted at the many cafés and tavernas operating there daily.
programme.sub-title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets - In the Belly of Thessaloniki

programme.title: Tasting History with Max Miller
programme.desc: Max explores medieval English taverns, inns, and alehouses, each serving different roles and social classes. Taverns sold wine, inns provided lodging, and alehouses were private homes selling ale. The episode covers wine quality control, bread and ale laws, and their reputations for gambling and excess. He recreates bokenade, a beef pottage with saffron, cloves, and verjuice.
programme.sub-title: Tasting History with Max Miller - What it was like to visit a Medieval Tavern

programme.title: Tasting History with Max Miller
programme.desc: Max explores the Old West saloon as a social hub for food and drink. He covers its evolving design, popular beverages like whiskey, beer, champagne, and cocktails, gambling games such as poker, and the famous "free lunch" tradition. The episode highlights regional foods, oysters' popularity, and recreates an 1886 pork and beans recipe from *Cooking for Profit*.
programme.sub-title: Tasting History with Max Miller - What Food was Served at Wild West Saloons?

programme.title: Tasting History with Max Miller
programme.desc: Max explores WWII home front rationing in the U.S., from 1942 sugar limits to the red and blue point system for meat, dairy, and canned goods. He covers price controls, Victory Gardens, labor shortages, internment camps, and black-market "meatleggers." He also recreates Betty Crocker's "emergency steak," a budget-friendly mix of ground beef, cereal, and milk.
programme.sub-title: Tasting History with Max Miller - Cooking on the American Home Front During WWII

programme.title: Tasting History with Max Miller
programme.desc: Max explores Titanic's luxurious first class, from modest suites to lavish parlor suites with private promenades. He covers dining in the saloon and Ritz, daily meals, amenities like the gym and Turkish bath, and the 10+ course final dinner. Using survivor accounts, he recreates the famous peaches in Chartreuse jelly dessert from April 14, 1912.
programme.sub-title: Tasting History with Max Miller - Dining First Class on the RMS Titanic

programme.title: Tasting History with Max Miller
programme.desc: Max explores Titanic's first class breakfast from April 11, 1912, featuring over a dozen dishes by Escoffier. He recreates baked apples, smoked salmon coronets, shirred eggs, and buckwheat cakes with blackcurrant conserve. The episode highlights dining venues, passenger pets, and the tragic story of honeymooners Victor and Maria Josefa Peñasco.
programme.sub-title: Tasting History with Max Miller - First Class Breakfast on the RMS Titanic

programme.title: Tasting History with Max Miller
programme.desc: Max explores the 4-6 month, 2,200-mile Oregon Trail journey (1846-1869), covering provisions like flour, bacon, and hardtack, cooking over buffalo chips, and staple meals like Johnny cakes. He discusses hunting, trading with Native Americans, celebrations, and hardships, including spoiled food, salt-rising bread, pies, and pioneers leaving possessions at Fort Laramie.
programme.sub-title: Tasting History with Max Miller - What Pioneers ate on the Oregon Trail

programme.title: Tasting History with Max Miller
programme.desc: Max recreates Ötzi the Iceman's last meal (c. 3,359-3,105BC), discovered in 1991. He covers Ötzi's clothing, tools, health (tattoos, heart disease, parasites), and likely murder by arrow. Using stomach contents-smoked ibex, charred red deer, and einkorn pancake with fiddle ferns-Max cooks over an open fire to mimic Neolithic methods.
programme.sub-title: Tasting History with Max Miller - Recreating the Last Meal of Ötzi the Iceman

programme.title: Tasting History with Max Miller
programme.desc: Max traces airline food from 1919's first commercial meal to aviation's Golden Age (1950s-70s). He covers flight kitchens, cold-to-hot meal evolution, themed flights, flight attendant hiring, the 1958 Great Sandwich War, and 1978 deregulation. Max recreates a 1954 United Airlines meal of pot roast, vegetables, Delmonico potatoes, and marshmallow-apple salad.
programme.sub-title: Tasting History with Max Miller - Airline Food During the Golden Age of Air Travel

programme.title: Tasting History with Max Miller
programme.desc: Max recreates Medieval Irish corned beef and cabbage from *The Vision of Mac Con Glinne* (c. 1100) with onion-leek pottage. He explores Ireland's rigid food hierarchy-peasants ate grains and salted meat, butter signified wealth, monks preferred game, nobles had fresh meat-and cultural practices like fosterage, the 7-year child-rearing system, and a satirical poem about King Cathal's gluttony.
programme.sub-title: Tasting History with Max Miller - Medieval Irish Food: Peasant to King

programme.title: Tasting History with Max Miller
programme.desc: Max explores lighthouse keeper life via an 1881 provisioning list and period recipes. He covers the isolated, demanding job-cleaning Fresnel lenses with mercury, trimming wicks, and cooking with limited supplies like flour, beans, and salt pork. Featuring keepers Henry Long, Mary Ryan, and Hannah Thomas, he recreates Fannie Farmer's 1896 Boston corn chowder with pilot bread.
programme.sub-title: Tasting History with Max Miller - Eating like a Lighthouse Keeper from the 1800's

programme.title: Ciao Italia

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini

programme.title: Cosmology: The History and Nature of Our Universe
programme.desc: Cosmology takes the entire universe as its subject, not just its form, structure and contents, but also the manner of its birth and evolution; looking at the origin of cosmology in creation stories and its relation to the journey ahead.

programme.title: Cosmology: The History and Nature of Our Universe
programme.desc: Introducing the hierarchy of structures in the universe; from planets to stars, galaxies, galaxy clusters and larger groupings of galaxies called the cosmic web; light travels at a finite speed, looking far away also means looking far back in time.

programme.title: Cosmology: The History and Nature of Our Universe
programme.desc: Discussing cosmic properties; the universe is lumpy at the scale of galaxies and galaxy clusters; at larger scales, it is smooth and similar in all directions; this property of homogeneity and isotropy is called the cosmological principle.

programme.title: Cosmology: The History and Nature of Our Universe
programme.desc: The most familiar constituents of the universe are atomic matter and light; neutrinos make up another component; 96 percent of the universe is dark energy and dark matter; the relative amounts of these constituents changes as the universe expands.

programme.title: Cosmology: The History and Nature of Our Universe
programme.desc: Taking a trip through the universal timeline from the big bang to a future of ever-accelerating expansion; the eight key stages between them include the condensation of atoms, the birth of the first stars and the formation of galaxies.

programme.title: Cosmology: The History and Nature of Our Universe
programme.desc: Astronomers overlap techniques of "distance ladder" to determine distances in the universe; triangulation works for nearby stars; observers use pulsating stars for farther objects, the rotation of galaxies and a class of supernova explosions.

programme.title: Cosmology: The History and Nature of Our Universe
programme.desc: Measuring the Doppler shift of galaxies in the early 20th century; observations reveal that they all were moving away from Earth; the more distant ones move faster, proportional to distance; this is the Hubble Law, implying the initial "big bang."

programme.title: Cosmology: The History and Nature of Our Universe
programme.desc: Professor Whittle defines distances in cosmology; the three important distances to consider is the emission distance when the light is set out; the current distance, when the light arrives; the distance the light travels.

The deadly slashing and thrusting of the Naginata evokes the battlefields of 12th century Japan, as Sensei Wataru Suzuki says "The Naginata was used to mow down horses and cavalry soldiers so slashing attacks to the shins is a characteristic of Naginata".
programme.sub-title: Warriors of Budo Episode Six: Naginata/Jodo

programme.title: Fly Dragon Mountain
programme.desc: A famous swordsman is out to revenge the death of his mother, but he kills the wrong man. Realizing his terrible mistake, he tries to find the real culprit for his sake and for the sake of the wrongly killed man's daughter.

programme.title: Thunder Prince
programme.desc: When Blue Thunder, a wise man who owns the secret of Carne Technique, is slaughtered by three greedy villains, his son swears revenge and goes to the forest to get the martial arts training he needs to defeat his enemies. But his journey is not easy, as he thought when Master Soul tries to teach him that the true power of the martial arts is a lot more than taking revenge. With Thunder Mantis on their trail they must find ways to use the jungle to their advantage.

programme.title: Duel of Karate
programme.desc: Twin baby boys are separated at birth when their kung fu master father and mother are slaughtered by an opposing kung fu clan. The two live separate lives, but fate later throws them into a duel to the death with each other. A master class in kung fu cinema highly recommended. Wall to wall action.

programme.title: Martial Arts History Museum Biography: Leo Fong
programme.desc: Filmmaker, martial arts legend, Leo Fong was one of the early pioneers of martial arts in America. From judo to jiu jitsu to choy lay fut to wing chun to Shaolin styles, Fong helped open the doors of the arts to a new generation. A former champion boxer, he was the first to introduce unique forms for weight training to the martial arts world.

programme.title: Dressed to Fire
programme.desc: Ruthless drug baron Lamar is determined to drive out a rival gang headed by a tough and beautiful businesswoman, Mandy. Two lovers who work for Lamar become disillusioned with the life of crime, but when Lamar kills Jane, Nick is wild with rage and vows to eliminate Lamar and his evil henchmen.

programme.title: Mad for Vengeance
programme.desc: The tiger screams and kills. His justice is revenge. Japanese forces are trying to establish power in Manchuria and plan to take control of the coal mines, bringing resistance from The Patriotic Dragons who are highly skilled in the martial arts. When the Japanese secret society get hold of a list of the patriot leaders and begin to bump them off, it is up to two cousins to infiltrate the society and take on Tanaka, an expert in karate. HIS WEAPON IS HIMSELF. HE IS THE HUMAN KILLING MACHINE.

programme.title: Martial Arts History Museum Biography: Steve Lambert
programme.desc: Steve Lambert was considered one of the most legendary stuntman and choreographer in the movie business. He has won multiple awards for his body of work. His film work consists of such bonafide classics as Revenge of the Ninja, American Ninja, Cop, Remo: The Adventure Begins, Relentless II, John Carpenter's Vampires, Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade, Total Recall and dozens of other blockbusters.

programme.title: Martial Arts History Museum Biography: Gerald Okamura
programme.desc: Officially called the "scariest man alive" by Black Belt magazine, we go behind the scenes of one of the most awesome Asian badguys, Gerald Okamura. From his iconic role at the Hatchett Man in "Big Trouble in Little China," to his many appearances as an evil bad dude, we explore Gerald Okamura's history, his life and his legendary career as one of the top weapons experts in America. Gerald Okamura was inducted into the Martial Arts History Museum's Hall of Fame in 2003.

programme.title: Snake in the Eagle's Shadow Pt 2
programme.desc: Ah Fu (Wang Tao) and Chen Ting Kuan (Carter Wong) are a couple of kung fu men in the escort service business with top notch kung fu styles. Ah Fu gets tired of the escort service and quits and takes up the life of a normal man. In his new "life", Ah Fu runs into a thief named Li Chi (Li Kun), and the two become the best of friends. Life is great! Ah Fu gets married to a pretty girl, Yu Lan (Ha Ling Ling). He has money, servants, and foot massages. What else could you want?

programme.title: The Empty Mind
programme.desc: This is our classic signature documentary. Over two years in the making, this is an epic account of today's greatest martial arts teachers and the mind connection that exists between them regardless of their remarkably diverse styles. Here is what the editor of Black Belt Magazine had to say: "I must say I was impressed.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Sonia se reúne con el cardenal para enseñarle la libreta que compromete a Ramiro con el narcotráfico, y recibe una amenaza de su esposo. Leonor y Marco Mejía pasan la noche juntos.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Eugenia se molesta con el cambio en el periódico. Mejía convence a Jiménez de no estar dispuesto a trabajar más con Leonor, y ella entra al estudio de grabación haciéndose pasar por fan de Alejo.

programme.desc: Marco le cuenta a Benítez la relación de Ramiro con el narco. El Turco convence al Topo Galván para ayudar a Aurelio y persuadir a los Villalobos. A Linares le dan de alta en el hospital.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio le dice a Guadalupe que elimine al cardenal, pero alguien más lo hace por él. Matilde le dice a Alba que le dará un dinero a cambio de quedarse con el niño, ya que es hijo de Chacorta.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Doña Alba le dice al Turco que algo le pasa a Ximena. Alfonso autoriza que el artículo que hizo Eugenia con respecto a la muerte del cardenal se publique sin ninguna modificación.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio conoce a Leonor y comienza a coquetearle, aunque ella disimula con Alejandro. Marco Mejía visita a Ramiro en su oficina y le pregunta por Sonia: él le dice que está en Londres con su hija.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Ximena pregunta a Aurelio si tuvo algo que ver con la muerte del cardenal. Él le promete a su esposa que va a cambiar, pero ella está decidida a escapar, por lo que le pide al Turco que la ayude.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Mónica se arrepiente de haber golpeado al Triste y le pide disculpas, dice que Casillas no le volverá a ver la cara de idiota. Ximena visita a Cleto, y el Turco se entera del plan de Aurelio.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Alba descubre a Ximena a punto de huir. Aurelio les dice al Cabo y a Tijeras que les dejará el territorio de los Robles y de los Villalobos. Cleto está preocupado, no sabe nada del cargamento.
programme.sub-title: Esta vida no es para mí

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El Turco le declara su amor a Ximena, y ella está dispuesta a dejar a Aurelio, pero él se despierta y nota su ausencia. Leonor dopa a Alejandro para que no se sobrepase con ella.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio está angustiado, le pide a su gente que suspendan todo y se dediquen a localizar a Ximena. El Topo Galván le propone a Óscar Cadena asociarse en los túneles que tiene a disposición.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Ximena decide regresar cuando Alba le cuenta que su padre está en terapia intensiva. Benítez le agradece al general Jiménez el haber detenido a don Cleto y darles un duro golpe a los carteles.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio golpea a su esposa y le dice que no podrá salir de la casa sin su permiso. Leonor queda preocupada al saber que Casillas descubrió su arma. Marco le ofrece a Ximena que ayude a Cleto.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El Pollo le cuenta al Topo Galván que don Cleto tuvo un infarto. Cabo se deprime por lo que pasó con Mónica. Víctor toma a Matilde por la fuerza, mientras Aurelio se mete en el cuarto de Leo.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Chacorta le pregunta a Heriberto si le gusta Matilde. Ponte y Orejas descubren que el Letrudo es el mismo general Jiménez. Leonor le asegura a Mejía que el Letrudo estuvo en la hacienda.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El Turco le dice a Aurelio que tiene los planos del hospital, pero que no tienen muchas opciones para liberar a don Cleto sin sufrir algunas bajas. Mientras, él se entera del plan de su suegro.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Pierde su brazo y ahora enfrenta un grave problema, no puede ejercer su profesión. Descubre que su pareja tenía otra familia y toma represalias, ahora le exigen el pago de los gastos médicos.
programme.sub-title: La vida es bella; La culpa es tuya

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Responsabiliza a Mayra del secuestro de su hijo, quiere que la ayude con el rescate. La residencia de ancianos lucra con la muerte al ofrecer sus cuerpos para pruebas con armas y explosivos.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Su mente le hace creer que padece enfermedades que él mismo se provoca, pero no quiere ir al psicólogo. Nace sin pene y le implantan uno biónico, pero al tener intimidad, cae en coma.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Su exesposo no quiere incluir en la división de bienes unas monedas valiosas. Morfeo le pide a su sacristán que cumpla sexualmente por él, y ahora Magdalena quiere manutención para su hijo.
programme.sub-title: Hasta que la realidad nos separe; Hijo del sacerdote

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Eva acusa a su novio Daniel de usar lubricante con éxtasis, ella da positivo en la prueba de drogas y la botan del trabajo. Carlos pide el divorcio porque Cindy le fue infiel con un famoso DJ.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: María exige que Elena le pague por los daños que su hija, con síndrome de Down, sufrió en su academia. Jaime es menor de edad y su madre pide la anulación de su boda, porque él la engañó.
programme.sub-title: Abusada con síndrome de Down; Me lo cazó

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Gleiber sufre las consecuencias de las caricaturas mal intencionadas de Jorge. En otro caso, Jenny quiere cumplir el último deseo de su hija de 12 años, antes de que la niña muera de cáncer.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Sebastián y José son hermanos que pelean por una uva que produce un excelente vino. Una pareja enfrenta un serio problema: la abuela padece una enfermedad que desinhibe los deseos sexuales.
programme.sub-title: El robo de la uva; Pick

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Sofía descubre que su marido cumplió prisión por asesinar y descuartizar a su exesposa. En otro caso, Catalina y Walid tienen una joyería, ella decide esconder unos diamantes.
programme.sub-title: Asesino en redes; El patrimonio de mi hijo

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Compra la empresa donde sufrió acoso y pone a su exjefe a trabajar como pene gigante. Los duques de Sealand, el país más pequeño del mundo, se enfrentan por títulos nobiliarios y propiedades.
programme.sub-title: Venganza fálica; Los duques de Sealand

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Su esposo la llama por el nombre de su abuela, ella descubre que es su abuelo. La esposa lo espera en tierra y para que no lo atrapen con su amante, la lanza de la avioneta en paracaídas.
programme.sub-title: Enamorado de la nieta; Yo te salvé la vida

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Victoria exige que la mujer de su exesposo le pague lo que le prestó, ella alega que vive en su casa gratis. Gustavo pide el divorcio, su mujer lo acusa de matar a la hija por la herencia.
programme.sub-title: Pegado a su ex; Desaparecida por la herencia

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Enyer le pide a su tío que cumpla el contrato que firmaron, él se niega porque no cuidó de su hijo. Angélica quiere abortar, cree que tiene al diablo en la barriga, su esposo busca internarla.
programme.sub-title: ¿Quién tiene la culpa?; La ecografía del diablo

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Un dúo de músicos urbanos denuncia que su productor los controla con un reloj que no pueden quitarse. Adrián cumple su deseo de vestirse y actuar como niña, su esposa le pide el divorcio.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Cristian le exige a su madre el dinero que su padre dejó para sus estudios, pero ese fondo ya no existe. En otro caso, Armando y su profesora bailan tango con mucha pasión y Jenny se molesta.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: A Camila la van a deportar por culpa de su exjefe Raúl, quien la envió en busca de mercancía y de un amigo ilegal. Mariana demanda a una periodista por informar que había defraudado al gobierno.
programme.sub-title: Viaje en deportación; A la luz pública

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Luis responsabiliza a Ricardo del suicidio de su hija, lo acusa de prostituirla en Las Vegas. Marta va a prisión por drogas y sus hijos se quedan con su hermana, quien no le permite verlos.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Katiuska exige que su madrastra pague sus deudas médicas, por su culpa ella perdió su embarazo. María Alejandra acusa a su esposo de usarla como moneda de cambio en una deuda, la violaron.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Efraín demanda a su padre por introducir dos colmillos de león en su maleta para pasarlos por la aduana. La mujer de Pedro se suicida en casa de Lourdes, él cree que ella la incitó.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Dos hermanos no se soportan y sus padres no saben cómo resolverlo. Sufre de una rara enfermedad, toma bebidas energéticas para no quedarse dormido, ahora no puede conciliar el sueño.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Un bebé muere por un "slime" que hicieron sus hermanos mientras estaban con su madrastra. Pide una canción biográfica para su matrimonio, el resultado es tan desastroso que se cancela la boda.
programme.sub-title: Slime; La canción de la desgracia

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Contagia de hepatitis A a su yerno y a un amigo, pero no a los nietos. Alina pierde su bote tras ponerlo como colateral de la fianza del hermano de su nuera Fary, y ahora quiere que se lo pague.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: El esposo de Jenny se ha convertido en un narcisista que solo aprecia su propia belleza. Por proteger la calidad de sus plantas de marihuana, elimina una gran cantidad de abejas del vecino.
programme.sub-title: El narcicista; Un instruso no deseado

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: La obesidad ayuda a José a luchar contra la eyaculación precoz, pero afecta su salud. Una madre pierde la custodia de sus hijos, porque su esposo hace peligrosos videos de bromas con ellos.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Adrián demanda al amante de su esposa por haber destruido deliberadamente su matrimonio. Juan está obsesionado con una muñeca inflable con apariencia de niña, su esposa está asustada.
programme.sub-title: El amante bandido; Muñeca menor de edad

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Brendan quiere abortar, pues el feto afecta su proceso de transformación, pero su pareja no está de acuerdo. Por enfermedad, convierte a su hija en su cuidadora, una responsabilidad de adultos.
programme.sub-title: Mi mujer me embarazó; La chef

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Alexander está hundido en la depresión, su amiga y terapeuta le decide aplicarle un tratamiento de choque y él piensa que morirá. Valentín demanda a Débora por arrancarle un testículo.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Stephany se graba desnuda para su canal de recetas veganas, pero su esposo distribuye el material en una web porno. Ramón usa su gallo como apoyo sexual, su vecino no soporta el canto del ave.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Seguramente se introduce en la casa de su familia verdadera y ahora la reclama como suya. Se hizo un anillo de compromiso con las cenizas de su padre, su madre se niega a que su esposo esté ahí.
programme.sub-title: Hija perdida; No es un polvo, es un diamante

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: La doctora Ana María Polo interviene en batallas legales que afectan a los latinos. Como en una corte, las partes presentan testigos y evidencias para que ella emita su decisión. Además, expertos contribuyen con sus conocimientos.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Johnny sufre un accidente tras enterarse de que uno de sus hijos no es suyo. Simón y Dolores están en pleno acto sexual, cuando el esposo de ella los sorprende, le mutila el miembro al amante.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Anthony exige que su hermano Edgard le pague por haberlo violado. Una madre se niega a entregarle dinero a su hijo para sus estudios, ella alega que no escogió una carrera profesional.
programme.sub-title: Hermano abusa a hermano; Universidad de influencers

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Liz y Joan tienen una hija albina, a quien le afecta vivir en Miami por su condición, la madre quiere irse del país. Bárbara exige que Rafael y Albert paguen por robarle sus clientes.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Verónica siente que su hermana la estafó emocionalmente, incitándola a enamorarse de una amiga con quien tenía un acuerdo de sacarle todo el dinero posible. La hermana alega que nada fue premeditado. Benjamín odia a las iguanas y a los indocumentados. El estado de Florida permite dispararle a las iguanas con rifles de balines y él, alegando que le estaba disparando a una iguana, le pegó un tiro en un ojo a Iván, quién, casualmente, es indocumentado.
programme.sub-title: Duplo golpe emocional; Balines contra iguanas

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Joan tiene la custodia total de su hija y Yuri descubre que la niña hace videos de "autobullying". En otro caso, la serpiente de Ángel y Rose se come al lindo perro de su vecina Katiana.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: Laa-Laa dances with her ball. A little boy tells us why he likes to live in his block of flats. A balloon appears in Teletubbyland. The Teletubbies follow a balloon.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies giggle as they play their 'Through the Arch' game. The windmill stops them to watch a little girl and her dad go for a walk in the town.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies line up to say 'Eh-oh' and then watch Matthew and Mark feed a baby calf. The Teletubbies play a game to see who can eat their Tubby Custard the slowest, but Po can't wait and eats her Tubby Custard very fast.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies and some children watch Tamzin Griffin pretend to be Funny Lady and tell the story of the Naughty Pig. Dipsy's hat keeps blowing away and he has to chase it all over Teletubbyland.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: Tinky Winky, Dipsy and Laa-Laa run into Home Hill to say 'Eh-oh', but where 's Po? Some children help their dad to wash his car. They get very wet and soapy.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Tubbies crawl through the arch in Home Hill and watch Alex Pascall and some children sing 'Handy Hands'.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies watch some children play with balls of different shapes and sizes. In Teletubbyland, something happens to Dipsy's hat.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: It's time for the Teletubbies to do their exercises. A voice trumpet rises and the Teletubbies stretch up and down to it's instructions.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies watch some children learn about the number two. Dipsy and Laa-Laa are eating Tubby Toast. They play the game 'Two Little Teletubbies', but while they are playing the Noo-Noo tidies up their Tubby Toast.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies take turns to stand on a hill, in front of the house, next to a tree under a cloud. Andy Brown and some children visit some giraffes. The animals march through Teletubbyland.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies are eating Tubby Toast. They stop to watch Amy making pasta. A ball of string appears in Teletubbyland. Po knocks the string in to the air with her scooter and it makes a stringy mess all over Teletubbyland.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: Tinky Winky calls the other Tubbies to come and watch Tamzin Griffin pretend to be Funny Lady and tell the story about the naughty sock. The Tubby Toast machine makes a tower of tubby toast.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies watch some children looking at penguins waddling and swimming. In Teletubbyland, the Tubbies play walk fast and slow, far and near and other different ways.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies play 'Boo', but stop to watch Ned help his dad plant and water some geraniums. In Teletubbyland, nine pretty flowers and a watering can appear.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies love playing on the slide. They stop to watch Andy Brown and some children digging in the sand for crabs.
